HT_1.rule: If PROBE_HARD_TIMEOUT_MS expires WITHOUT affirmative evidence that the provider/upstream is unreachable or faulty: classification = UNKNOWN.
HT_1.consequence: HTTP 200, body explicitly non-healthy UNKNOWN, runner INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS, never health FAIL.

HT_2.rule: AS-3 / HTTP 503 / health FAIL applies ONLY when there is affirmative evidence of provider unreachable, upstream health fault, or equivalent technical evidence establishing real unavailability.
